body:
Expose automatic 2D/3D nesting commands, layout metrics, and cut-side overrides in the MCP server and update agent workflow documentation.

Depends on #2160, #2161, and #2166.

## Scope

- **MCP tools (`crates/app/src/mcp/`):**
  - Add `create_nest`, `edit_nest`, `add_nest_part`, `remove_nest_part`, `set_nest_profile_side`, `run_nesting`, `get_nest`, and `delete_nest` calling the `crates/app` undoable commands through `History`.
  - Allow `add_nest_part` to accept `Sketch` names or 3D model names (`STEP`, `STL`, `OBJ`, `.sc`), `quantity`, optional `sheet_face` id, and `outline_only`.
  - Include nest summaries (sheet count, per-sheet `placed_counts` per model, `utilization_pct`, material preset, and unplaced parts) in `get_job` and `get_nest`.
  - Refuse unknown keys, bad quantities, invalid cut-side strings, gaps below router tool diameter, and unplaceable parts by name (`isError: true`).
- **Docs and integration test:**
  - Document the nesting workflow (import sketches or 3D models, create nest, set cut sides, run nesting, generate, verify, post) in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`.
  - Add `crates/app/tests/mcp_nest.rs` exercising `create_nest`, `add_nest_part`, `set_nest_profile_side`, `run_nesting`, `get_nest`, `generate`, `verify`, `post`, `undo`, and `redo`.

## Done means

`crates/app/tests/mcp_nest.rs` passes an end-to-end headless nest-to-post flow with `undo` and `redo`, reports sheet count, per-sheet model counts, utilization %, and cut order accurately, refuses invalid arguments by name, and `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` documents every new tool.

Part of #2156
